item.title: My Rust as-of join is slower than Polars
item.description: A Rust as-of join I claimed was faster than Polars. A reproducible benchmark showed the opposite, and a rebuild of the March kernel did not bring the lead back.

item.title: Optical Cables and Multicast: Why Your Network Hardware Matters More Than You Think

item.title: Cache Eviction: 30 Years of Improvements
item.description: How cache hierarchies and eviction policies evolved over three decades, from simple in-memory buffers to modern tiered caches, and what the data says about their effectiveness.
